tasks.title: Record refusal decision
tasks.description: Record the supplied refusal and metadata-preservation decision, including the owner deployment boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: The recorded decision requires refusal before writes and unchanged metadata for conflicting destinations.
tasks.notes: Supplied fixture history: decision-review compared the recorded decision with REQ-REFUSAL and REQ-OWNER; both matched. Recorded decision: conflicting destinations require refusal before writes and unchanged metadata; owner deployment is excluded. Typecheck was inapplicable to this decision-only outcome. This establishes the decision, not product execution.

sourceRefs.content: REQ-REFUSAL: Conflicting destinations must refuse before writes and preserve metadata. REQ-OWNER: Owner-controlled deployment is excluded from this task.

verification.expected: The decision-only outcome contains no executable source or type declarations.
verification.reason: This task records the supplied policy decision.

verification.expected: Procedure: compare the recorded decision in notes with REQ-REFUSAL and REQ-OWNER. Evidence: identify its refusal-before-write, unchanged-metadata and excluded-deployment statements.
verification.reason: Agreement with the supplied requirements establishes the decision outcome.

tasks.title: Verify refusal contract
tasks.description: Review inline current refusal contract and document reproducible evidence in progress without product edits.
acceptanceCriteria: No-write refusal and preserved metadata guarantees are confirmed from current evidence.

sourceRefs.content: REQ-REFUSAL: Conflicting destination refuses before writes and preserves metadata.

requiredContext.content: Owner-controlled deployment remains out of scope. The refusal and metadata-preservation contract is known, but current inspection evidence has not been supplied.

verification.expected: Read-only evidence review contains no source changes.
verification.reason: The bounded task only reviews supplied evidence.

verification.expected: Procedure: once current inspection evidence is supplied, compare it with REQ-REFUSAL and record whether both guarantees hold. Retain the comparison evidence; missing evidence cannot pass this check.
verification.reason: The comparison establishes the selected verification outcome.

verification.expected: Obtain owner-approved current inspection evidence before running contract-review.
verification.reason: Current metadata-preservation evidence is missing; obtain owner-approved inspection.
